note: Crash report v2 (#13379) is a page's report whose frames carry their code offsets. It is v1's lines with two changes: the first line is `crash 2`, and a frame is `f NAME` or `f NAME +0xOFFSET`, OFFSET being the frame's byte offset in the module's file in lowercase hex (what the browser's stack prints after wasm-function[N]). The offset is what resolves to a Coax line after the fact, from the module's DWARF or wasm-objdump. The signature and so the bucket are v1's: the kind and the three innermost Coax functions' names, never an offset. A room's report stays v1 (proto/verse/crash-report-v1.json): its frames already carry FILE:LINE. The API builds a page's report as v2 and reads v1 and v2.

lines.value: a Coax trap's own line, PATH:LINE: WHAT
NAME, or NAME +0xOFFSET (the byte offset in the module file, 1 to 16 lowercase hex digits); innermost first, at most 24
KIND|NAME|NAME|NAME: the kind and the three innermost Coax functions; KIND|TEXT when no frame has one

pages.why: a Coax trap in a page: its frames named from the module's symbols, each with its code offset; the last frame's offset was not given

source page

release everglade2.9c2aa0c8e19b.wasm

f abort +0x1f3a2
f coax_trap +0x1f40c

f frame
sig trap|page_crash_test|frame
